# Asygn SDK Example Sources

This directory contains unmodified copies of two examples from the
Asygn Colibry NPU SDK.

## Included examples

- `40_video_numbers_ble/main.c` — camera/video capture reference.
- `50_person_detector/main.c` — person detector firmware reference.

## Original source

The files were copied from:

- `colibryNPU_SDK/examples/40_video_numbers_ble/main.c`
- `colibryNPU_SDK/examples/50_person_detector/main.c`
